name: Fast Item Frames

mechanics.title: Block-based frames
mechanics.description: Frames react instantly to supporting blocks breaking or moving with pistons, work with /setblock, and multiple frames can still share a block space.

mechanics.title: Dyeing
mechanics.description: Dye item frames like leather armor for millions of colours.

mechanics.title: Invisible frames
mechanics.description: Shift + right-click with an empty hand hides the frame and shows the item larger.

mechanics.title: Waxing
mechanics.description: Use honeycomb on a frame to lock it against rotation, changes or visibility toggling.

mechanics.title: Name-tag hiding and conversion
mechanics.description: Optional hiding of custom item names while looking at displayed items; optional conversion of existing vanilla item frame entities to blocks when chunks load.

vanilla_changes.what: Item frame and glow item frame
vanilla_changes.change: Item frame (or glow item frame) + any dye (crafting_dye recipe) -> dyed item frame / dyed glow item frame.
Placed frames become blocks rather than entities.

commands_and_keybinds: Shift + right-click (empty hand): toggle frame invisibility
summary: Reimplements item frames as blocks instead of entities for better performance, and adds dyeing, invisible frames and waxing.
